name: Launch
headline: Launch — Enamel Dutch Oven 5qt · date Sep 12

data.dialNote: Realify will build the launch plan and the checklist, then wait. Every system write — listing, PO, ads, email — needs your approval.

milestones.label: Review milestone
milestones.note: Seeded through the review program at a 4.3 minimum average, or the listing loses conversion.

milestones.label: Rank target · Amazon
milestones.note: Category rank by day 60. Currently no presence on the term.

milestones.label: Rank target · Google
milestones.note: Organic by day 90, paid from day one.

milestones.label: Content live
milestones.note: Seven-shot set, three A+ modules, video on DTC only at launch.

sequencing.name: DTC-first
sequencing.detail: Launch on northwind.com Sep 12, Amazon Oct 03, Walmart Oct 17. Reviews and content read come from our own traffic first.

tradeoffs.text: Launch promo stays off the marketplace price ladder
First 25 reviews come from email list buyers · 4.6 average historically
Costs about three weeks of Amazon velocity and delays the rank build

sequencing.name: Amazon-first
sequencing.detail: Launch on Amazon Sep 12 with DTC live but unpromoted, Walmart Oct 03. Buys velocity and rank fastest.

tradeoffs.text: Rank build starts three weeks earlier · top 20 reachable by day 40
Launch promo sets the reference price on the ladder
Cannibalization on the 4qt is sharper · same shopper, same page

data.seqNote: DTC-first gives us the reviews and the content read before Amazon sees the listing, and it protects the launch promo from the marketplace price ladder. It costs about three weeks of Amazon velocity and delays the rank build.

kill.rule: Kill if under 180 units at a spend cap of $2.5K
Kill if CVR is under 4.0% with content live and 500+ sessions
Kill if the review average sits under 3.8 across 15+ reviews
Kill if returns exceed 12% on 40+ units shipped

agents.name: Merchandiser
agents.role: Owns the content pack, the listing build and the launch narrative.

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Sizes the initial buy and the follow-on PO gate.

agents.name: Bidder
agents.role: Builds the launch ad plan inside the $2.5K cap.

agents.name: Pricer
agents.role: Owns list, launch promo and MAP posture.

agents.name: Promoter
agents.role: Owns the email and SMS announcement and the review program.

agents.name: Arbiter
agents.role: Sequences the checklist and resolves conflicts between the five.
